title: In-process native Panel lifecycle binding
summary: Validate and pin the existing gemia panel descriptor, then delegate mount/destroy to the trusted Host lifecycle. The descriptor contains no package renderer code.

replaceability.why: Trusted integrity and binding machinery remains controlled by Lumeri.

operations.name: NativePanelBinding
operations.notes: No fixed operation deadline is enforced. Validates with gemia.plugin_surfaces.validate_descriptor and stores detached canonical JSON. Full native descriptor schema is draft; UI rendering belongs to the editor area.

operations.name: compile
operations.notes: No fixed operation deadline is enforced. Requires native-ui-panel surface, exact normalized native descriptor and fixed input/output schemas. Exact ui.mount grant and interaction.mount/update required Host APIs; editable must be none. Mismatches raise ValueError without a code.

operations.name: invoke
operations.notes: No fixed operation deadline is enforced. Inputs shown are arguments; capability/context are trusted binding parameters. Requires attached trusted lifecycle and same Host app. Output is lifecycle-specific. Mount/destroy changes session UI state, not an atomic Project/client_op_id transaction; no Project revision is advanced here.

invariants.text: A native Panel cannot run without a trusted lifecycle and cannot use a context bound to another Host app.

break: Validation failure or an unavailable native dependency.
failure.notes: This original seam does not install replacement layers or implement automatic original fallback.

conformance.notes: No replacement conformance runner is attached.

known_deviations.text: The factory binds the Video tasks panel; lifecycle is optional and a descriptor alone does not prove the panel can mount.
